description:
Turn the relevant logical consumer baselines into one bounded private BitSlice copy-avoidance experiment before prototype samples are collected.

## Background

BitSlice remains a bit view and the experiment may use only a private measurement prototype. The portfolio fixes one measured consumer, copy-inclusive comparator, offset/alignment cases, complexity budget, and stop rule without authorizing public borrowed-word API or production semantics.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The portfolio names one exact private prototype, consumer cell, baseline, offset/alignment cases, profile rationale, implementation complexity budget, comparison family, and stop condition before candidate measurement.
- [hard] REQ-02: A missing consumer signal is recorded as a no-candidate outcome and leaves production unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-03: No public borrowed-word API, shared-infrastructure change, or production route is authorized by the portfolio.

## Notes

This is an experimental selection contract, not an architecture or production adoption decision.
title: Freeze the private zero-copy candidate
